info.meta: An overview of supported &ha; solutions for &hana; and &nw; on &productname;

abstract.para: &sles4sap; is the leading Linux platform for &hana;, &sap; &s4hana;, and &netweaver;, and an Endorsed App by &sap;. Two of the key components of &productnameshort; are &sleha; (&slehaa;) and resource agents (RAs). &slehaa; provides &pace;, an open-source cluster framework. The resource agents manage automated failover of &hanasr;, &s4hana; ASCS/ERS, and &nwshort; ASCS/ERS.

section.title: HA solutions for &s4hana; based on ABAP Platform 1809 or newer
section.para: &ensa2long; (&ensa2;) is the successor to &ensa1long; (&ensa1;). Starting from ABAP Platform 1809, &ensa2long; is the default installation. The use of the new &ensa2long; and Enqueue Replicator 2 provides an improved &ha; architecture with robust and fast replication, and failover.
The support details are for high level overview only. Refer to the official documentation for the full conditions.

table.title: Supported configurations for &s4hana; based on ABAP Platform 1809 or newer

row.entry: In a 2-node cluster, ASCS fails over to the same node where ERS is running.
In a 3-node cluster, ASCS fails over to the online node where ERS is not running.
Shared file system mounts are NOT managed by the cluster. This is the recommended configuration over the Filesystem resource-based solution.

Shared file system mounts are managed by the cluster via the Filesystem resource agent. &suse; still supports this configuration, but it is not recommended for new installations. Use the simple mount file system structure instead.
Multiple &sap; ASCS/SCS clustered instances are supported in the same cluster.
Additional dialog or other instances in cluster
Although it is possible to run Application Servers in the same cluster where ASCS/ERS are running, it is not recommended for easy management of the cluster.
Supported (Documentation for the Filesystem resource-based setup; not yet documented for the simple mount structure)

entry.para: This solution combines the following resources into one cluster resource group:

listitem.para: An &sap; instance including the sapwebdisp service
A file system where the &sap; instance is running
An IP address used by the clients of the service

section.title: HA solutions for &netweaver; based on ABAP Platform 1709 or older
section.para: Under the &ensa1long; (&ensa1;), the ASCS has to fail over to the cluster node where the active ERS is running, because it needs to access the shared memory that stores the enqueue replication table.
The support details are for high level overview only. Refer to the official documentation for the full conditions.
